title: pbiplint configuration
description: Rules on or off, severity overrides, rule options, the fail threshold, and custom rule files. Saved as pbiplint.config.json next to the project or anywhere above it.

rules.description: Rule id to "off", to a severity that replaces the rule's own, or to an object with a severity and the rule's options. Ids match regardless of case.

oneOf.description: A severity override and the options the rule declares (see its page).

failOn.description: Lowest severity that makes the command line exit 1.

customRules.description: Tabular Editor rule files to run as rules on the semantic model. Each entry is a path to a local file, relative to the folder this file is in; a URL or an absolute path is refused.
